in_marathi.name: Rakshita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rakshita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who protects, the guardian one. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word rakshana, which means protection.
